text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, like iOS or Android, and often perform better. Cross-platform apps work on both systems, which saves time and money. Responsive design is also essential, so apps look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps are published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance matters most: users expect fast, smooth apps, so developers must test carefully and fix problems before release. Good planning helps create successful apps.
